scope: Licenses read out of the pinned source archive itself, for components whose publisher record declares none. Each entry names the archive, its verified digest, the license file inside it and that file's digest, so the reading can be repeated exactly. This resolves the license of the named artifact; it is not a licensing opinion about how the artifact may be used and not an independent audit.
method: The archive was downloaded from the pinned URL, its SHA-256 compared against the identity already recorded in this repository, and the license file read from inside the verified archive. No license was inferred from a project name or from another release.
